transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I’m having a really hard time concentrating and making decisions at work, even on tasks that used to feel straightforward. It's gotten to the point where I'm struggling to get through my daily case reviews, and I realized I needed to seek some help.
Have you also been feeling down or losing interest in things you usually enjoy, or is the main problem trouble concentrating and staying organized?

Both are actually major issues, though the concentration problems at work are what finally pushed me to seek help. I’ve also really lost interest in things I used to love, like my Saturday morning gardening or volunteering at the food pantry. Now, I just feel numb and find myself going through the motions, wondering why I even bothered to show up.
Have you been feeling sad or down most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I wouldn't say I feel "sad" in the traditional sense, but more just completely numb and empty. It's like I'm totally drained of any real emotion, and I'm not quite sure how else to describe it.
Over the past two weeks, have you had any changes in sleep or appetite, low energy, feelings of worthlessness or guilt, slowed down or restless movements, or thoughts that life is not worth living?

Yes, to almost all of that; I wake up at 3 AM with my mind spinning, feel completely drained of energy, and my appetite has plummeted to the point where my clothes are loose. I constantly replay my mistakes, feeling worthless and like I’m not helping anyone anymore. Sometimes it feels so heavy that I think it would be a relief just not to wake up, or I'll idly imagine crashing my car on the highway, though I don't have a plan to do anything.
Have you ever had a period of at least several days when you felt unusually energized or irritable, needed much less sleep than usual, or felt overly confident or impulsive?
No, I've never had periods like that where I felt unusually energized or overly confident. In fact, it's been quite the opposite for me—I just feel constantly drained, tired, and low.
Have these symptoms been present most days for at least two weeks, or have they lasted for several months?

They have been going on for much longer than just a few weeks. These feelings have actually been building gradually for about a year and a half now, starting around the time my youngest child left for college and my job role shifted.
Have you been feeling nervous, on edge, or worrying excessively about different things most days, with trouble controlling the worry?

I don't really feel "nervous" or "on edge" in an anxious way. While my mind does spin at night, it is more about replaying my mistakes, feeling guilty, and overthinking my decisions rather than general worry.
Have your low mood, loss of interest, and other symptoms been present most days for at least 2 years without a period of feeling back to your usual self?

No, it hasn't quite been a full two years, but it has been about a year and a half of feeling like this consistently. I haven't had any real breaks or periods where I felt back to my usual self since it all started nineteen months ago.

Have you ever had a period of at least 2 months during the past 19 months when you felt back to your usual self, or has this low mood and loss of interest been present nearly every day the whole time?

No, I haven't had any periods of feeling back to my usual self at all. Since the transition nineteen months ago, it has just been a continuous, gradual downward slide without any breaks or relief. These feelings have been present nearly every single day.

Have you ever had any period of at least 2 months during the past 19 months when you felt back to your usual self, or has this low mood and loss of interest been present nearly every day the whole time?

No, I haven't had any periods of feeling back to normal at all. It has been a continuous, daily struggle for the entire nineteen months since my youngest left and my job changed. There hasn't been any break or relief from these feelings.
Have you had any periods during this time when your symptoms were much milder or you felt back to your usual self for at least a couple of months, or has it been low most days without any real break?

It has really been low most days without any real break. I haven't had a single period over these nineteen months where I felt back to my usual self or even noticed the symptoms getting milder. It has just been a steady, continuous struggle.
Have these symptoms made it very hard for you to function at work or at home, and have you had any thoughts that others might be trying to harm you or that you hear/see things other people don't?

Yes, it has made functioning very difficult; I've started missing small details in my case reviews, my supervisor has questioned my performance, and at home I'm canceling plans with friends and letting chores pile up. However, I definitely haven't experienced any thoughts of people trying to harm me, nor have I seen or heard things that others don't.

Before these symptoms started 19 months ago, had you ever had a period of at least 2 months when you felt back to your usual self, or has your mood and interest level been low for as long as you can remember?

Yes, before nineteen months ago, I felt like my usual self for many years and maintained a really good balance in my life. These struggles with my mood and lack of interest only started after my youngest left for college and my role at the hospital shifted. Up until those major changes, I had never experienced anything like this.

Have you ever had a period of at least 2 months during the past 19 months when you felt back to your usual self, or has this low mood and loss of interest been present nearly every day the whole time?

No, I haven't had any periods of feeling back to my usual self. It has been a continuous, gradual decline over the entire nineteen months since my youngest left and my job shifted, with no real break at all.
Did your symptoms start before age 21, or did they begin only in the last couple of years?

No, they only started recently, when I was 48 years old about a year and a half ago. I never experienced anything like this before age 21, or at any other point in my life before my youngest left for college and my job role shifted.

Have you ever had a period of at least 2 months in the past 19 months when you felt back to your usual self, or has the low mood and loss of interest been present nearly every day without a real break?

No, there hasn't been any period of two months where I felt back to my usual self. These feelings have been present nearly every single day for the entire nineteen months without a real break. It has just been a steady, continuous struggle since everything changed.
Have you had any thoughts of actually harming yourself or making a plan to end your life?

No, I don't have any concrete plan to end my life or harm myself. However, I do have passive thoughts like wishing I just wouldn't wake up in the morning, or idly imagining crashing my car on the highway. It is more of a persistent feeling that everyone might just be better off without me.

Have you ever had a period of at least 2 months during the past 19 months when you felt back to your usual self, or has the low mood and loss of interest been present nearly every day without a real break?

No, I haven't had any breaks like that at all. It has been a continuous, daily struggle that has gradually built up over the entire nineteen months since my youngest left and my role shifted. I haven't felt back to my usual self for even a short period during this time.

Have you ever had a period of at least 2 months during this 19-month stretch when you felt back to your usual self, even briefly, or has it been low mood and loss of interest nearly every day the whole time?

No, I haven't had any period of relief or felt back to my usual self at all during these nineteen months. It has been a continuous, gradually worsening struggle nearly every single day since my youngest left and my job shifted.
Have you ever had a previous episode like this before, with at least two weeks of depression or loss of interest, that later fully improved?
No, I have never experienced an episode like this before. This is the very first time in my life that I have felt this way.
Have you ever had any earlier episodes of depression or loss of interest before this one, even if they fully improved later?
No, I've never experienced anything like this in the past. This is the very first time in my life that I've ever had these kinds of feelings of depression or loss of interest.
